hypothesis: V51 identifies the minimal operator-relative QPE+D state, but sign-only retention discards structural-null support and deployment partial-order information. A hurdle factorization over effect support plus conditional outcome ordering is required for selected-outcome deployment sufficiency.
population: exact provenance-locked V50.5 TRAIN paired population: 502 full-set frozen RSMR proposals
evidence_source: same metric-safe paired one-shot closed-loop treatment/control outcomes; no new label collection
state_policy: exact V51 QPE+DOSE additive state; DOSE-X interactions are not carried forward

arms.name: HURDLE-SIGN
arms.functional: effect-support pairwise hurdle + conditional beneficial/nonbeneficial sign pairwise risk
arms.question: Is structural-null/effect factorization alone sufficient once the V51 state is fixed?

arms.name: HURDLE-PARETO
arms.functional: same effect-support hurdle + Pareto pairwise outcome risk over official-score delta and all hard-safety deltas
arms.question: If sign compression is still insufficient, is an unweighted deployment partial order over utility and safety required?

pareto_order: bad is paired against good only when bad has <= official-score delta and <= every hard-safety delta, with at least one strict inequality; ambiguous safety/utility trade-offs are omitted, never scalarized

identification_gate.effect_support: OOF support-risk AUC > 0.5 aggregate and >=4/5 folds
identification_gate.HURDLE-SIGN: conditional nonbeneficial AUC on effectful events > exact V51 sign-risk control aggregate and >=4/5 folds
identification_gate.HURDLE-PARETO: OOF Pareto-pair concordance > exact V51 sign-risk control aggregate concordance and >=4/5 folds

deployment_gate: exact V50/V51 paired causal deployment gate unchanged

frozen.calibration: single finite-rank split-conformal threshold on beneficial calibration events; no alpha split
frozen.runtime_operator: same frozen winner or incumbent; veto-only; no rerank/second-best/fallback
frozen.outcome_evidence: V50.5 metric-safe paired one-shot closed-loop outcomes

branches.HURDLE-SIGN pass: promote minimal hurdle functional, freeze immediately, untouched paired validation
branches.only HURDLE-PARETO pass: promote Pareto-ordered functional, freeze immediately, untouched paired validation
branches.functional identified but deployment fai: static operator-relative state+functional exhausted; next evidence/state must be paired temporal closed-loop outcome process, not offline feature expansion
branches.support identified but conditional order: current scalar operator-relative state is insufficient for structured conditional outcomes; next state acquisition must remain paired/on-policy
branches.support fail: ENGINEERING/scientific audit because V51 scalar-D effect-support signature must replay before further algorithm change

prohibited: QPE+D state expansion during this test
V46 response variance or handcrafted temporal-profile resurrection
fresh_policy: untouched validation remains unconsumed unless TRAIN preferred arm passes; after PASS no TRAIN tuning is permitted
